description: A bolted-down table, four chairs, a fan that turns by hand. One chair keeps the red pencil. The papers on the table are the reason anyone descends the corridor at all.
Dosimeters in a row on a felt-lined tray beside a brass clock on a leather hinge. The clockmaker works here. Every figure has a drift, and the drift is normal.
A chalkboard in the children's corridor, numbers in children's chalk and adults' fingers, half-erased guesses and one date. The midwife writes in pencil so the truth can change its mind quietly.
